summary: Verified payment flow (both backend + frontend) after env fixes. Backend payment_flow_check.py: 13/13 passed (SIWE auth, $1 access quote/submit with unknown tx stays unpaid, open-market order status 'awaiting_payment', unknown tx stays submitted/no gold granted, Robinhood RPC chainId=4663, Coinbase ETH-USD reachable). Frontend home loads cleanly without the previous 'Missing MetaMask connection URLs' overlay; START GAME navigates to /loadout; RainbowKit Connect Wallet modal renders MetaMask, Rainbow, Coinbase Wallet, WalletConnect and Browser Wallet. No runtime JS errors.

issues: Minor: 'REQUIREDROBINHOOD CHAIN IDENTITY' is missing a space between 'REQUIRED' and 'ROBINHOOD'

action_items: Optional: fix the missing space between 'REQUIRED' and 'ROBINHOOD CHAIN IDENTITY' label on the loadout page.

Optional: Reown AppKit prints a warning 'Failed to fetch remote project configuration' because window.fetch is wrapped by assets.emergent.sh/scripts/emergent-main.js; AppKit falls back to local defaults so the connect modal still works - safe to ignore but can be noted.

Optional: 'WalletConnect Core is already initialized' warning indicates wagmi/RainbowKit config is being instantiated twice (likely due to React strict mode or dual provider mount); not blocking but worth deduping.
critical_code_review_comments: Both reported bugs (CORS allow-list rejecting '*' in SIWE challenge, stale 'created' status on market order, missing MetaMask env vars crashing home) are resolved.
test_credentials: Admin password deadzone-admin-2026 (not needed for payment tests). SIWE wallets generated on-the-fly via eth_account inside payment_flow_check.py.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Payment & wallet flow is fully green. If you need to re-verify, just run: cd /app && python3 tests/payment_flow_check.py (expects 13/13). Frontend has data-testid gaps on main CTA/connect-wallet buttons; selectors used :has-text instead. Reown project id 10f1503b8120505486fb214934a81f58 is active; remote config fetch warn is caused by Emergent fetch wrapper and is cosmetic.
rca of the issue: Previous crash was due to walletConfig.js throwing when REACT_APP_METAMASK_WALLET_LINK/REACT_APP_METAMASK_DOWNLOAD_URL were absent; adding both to frontend/.env resolved the overlay. SIWE challenge previously 403'd because player_auth.create_challenge rejected CORS_ORIGINS='*'; setting CORS_ORIGINS to the exact preview URL in backend/.env fixed it. Market order previously returned stale 'created' status - server.py now returns the fresh order with 'awaiting_payment'.
